title: Home
description: The Alpharetta High School Orchestras — approximately 130 students in six levels of daily string instruction in Alpharetta, Georgia.

blocks.md:
The Alpharetta High School Orchestra, located in Alpharetta, Georgia has approximately 130 students participating in 6 distinct levels of daily string/orchestra instruction. The program focuses on improving string technique, musicianship, ear training, and both solo and ensemble playing to prepare students to be thriving, independent musicians. The orchestra program has students who are extremely enthusiastic and dedicated to their craft.

The orchestra is fortunate to have incredible facilities and equipment, a supportive administrative team, and an amazing parent booster organization.

blocks.heading: About the Program
blocks.md: The nationally recognized Alpharetta High School orchestra program was established in the fall of 2004 and is comprised of six orchestras and about 130 members. Alpharetta High School Orchestras strive for excellence in music education at the high school level.

blocks.heading: The Orchestras
blocks.md: The Alpharetta High School Orchestra program is made up of six ensembles: the Concert, Silver, Philharmonia, Sinfonia, Symphony, and Chamber orchestras. The orchestras have consistently achieved Superior ratings at adjudications and have travelled to perform locally, statewide, and nationally.

blocks.heading: About the Director
blocks.md: Jake Hood was named Director of Orchestras at Alpharetta High School in 2022.

blocks.text: With an orchestra, you are building citizens, better citizens for the community.
